name: Create a PrivateLink endpoint
description: Create a PrivateLink endpoint Creates a PrivateLink endpoint for a project. POST /v1/networking/privatelink/endpoints
context:
POST /v1/networking/privatelink/endpoints
Creates a PrivateLink endpoint for a project.
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.; body (body)

name: Delete a PrivateLink endpoint
description: Delete a PrivateLink endpoint Deletes a PrivateLink endpoint. DELETE /v1/networking/privatelink/endpoints/{endpointId}
context:
DELETE /v1/networking/privatelink/endpoints/{endpointId}
Deletes a PrivateLink endpoint.
Required: projectId (query) — The project ID the PrivateLink endpoint belongs to.; endpointId (path) — The unique identifier of the PrivateLink endpoint.
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.
